$comment: CANONICAL FEATURE REGISTRY (IA_PLAN_2026-07-28.md §0 rule 3, §9d - FROZEN). One entry per capability; every surface (homepage, features hub, footer, pricing, comparison, future docs/onboarding) REFERENCES this file, never keeps its own list. Cards render `outcome` (a declarative one-liner - NEVER the buying question; owner law 2026-07-28); `buying_question` remains the page-planning field. OWNER DECISION 2026-07-28: there are NO feature detail pages; /features.html is the single features surface and every capability renders there as a static card with a descriptive outcome line. Catalog link law: a card links ONLY when its owner is a /features/ page (standalone or anchored); capabilities owned elsewhere (numbers storefront, hub sections) render as static cards until their feature-owned home ships. Verified by tools/site-system.mjs. status: live | promised (brand-paragraph capability, pre-launch) | planned (NEVER rendered anywhere). anchor: null means the owner page top (Wave 2 pages add their anchors on shipping). surfaces: which surfaces may render the capability; adding a surface is a new string, never a schema change.

features.name: Local & toll-free numbers
features.buying_question: Can I get the right kind of number?
features.notes: Owned by the /numbers/ hub (local merged there permanently)
features.outcome: Get a number in the area code your customers dial, or an 800-style number for a national presence. Use both together if it helps.

features.name: Port your number
features.buying_question: Can I bring the number my customers already call?
features.outcome: Designed to support bringing the business number your customers already call. Join early access and we'll share porting details when setup opens.

features.name: Main greeting
features.buying_question: Can callers hear a professional greeting?
features.notes: Scripts library is the live owner until /features/extensions ships
features.outcome: Record a welcome in your own words. Callers hear the business, not a personal cell, from the first second.

features.name: Extensions
features.buying_question: Can callers dial a person or team directly?
features.notes: Wave 2A page live 2026-07-28; one page for greeting + menus + extensions per frozen IA
features.outcome: Give every person and department a direct number like 101, forwarded to the mobiles they already carry.

features.name: After-hours greetings
features.buying_question: Can I set a different greeting for holidays?
features.outcome: A different welcome outside business hours, so evening and weekend callers know what happens next.

features.name: Call forwarding
features.buying_question: Can calls reach the right person's mobile?
features.outcome: Send calls to your business number to the right person's mobile. Nothing to install, no desk phones required.

features.name: Call schedules
features.buying_question: Can routing change after hours or on holidays?
features.outcome: Change where calls go by time: one path during business hours, another after hours and on holidays.

features.name: Call transfers
features.buying_question: Can I pass a live call to a teammate?
features.notes: NOT rendered: owner has not confirmed the capability is shipped

features.name: Voicemail to email & Slack
features.buying_question: Can voicemails land where my team already looks?
features.outcome: Voicemails arrive where the team already looks: the shared inbox, email, or a Slack channel you choose.

features.name: Business texting
features.buying_question: Can customers text my business number?
features.outcome: Customers text the business number and the team replies from it. Photos and messages stay with the business.

features.name: Shared SMS inbox
features.buying_question: Can my whole team answer one business number?
features.notes: The team page is the standalone story; the inbox is its section
features.outcome: Every text lands in one inbox the whole team can see, so a conversation never gets stuck on one phone.

features.name: Callbacks from the business number
features.buying_question: Can I call customers back showing the business number?
features.outcome: Call customers back from the business number using your own mobile; they see the business, not your cell.

features.name: Mobile app
features.buying_question: Can I run the business line on the phone I already have?
features.outcome: Run the business line on the phone you already have: answer, call back, text, and check voicemail.

features.name: Slack notifications
features.buying_question: Can my team see calls where they already work?
features.outcome: Send missed calls, texts, and voicemail summaries into the Slack channels your team watches.

features.name: WhatsApp
features.buying_question: Can customers WhatsApp my business number?
features.outcome: Customers message the same business number on WhatsApp, and it lands in the shared inbox.

features.name: Webhooks
features.buying_question: Can events reach my own tools?
features.outcome: Send call and message events to your own tools and workflows.

features.name: Using third-party AI services
features.buying_question: Can I plug in the answering service I choose?
features.notes: Label fixed verbatim by CLAUDE.md label law
features.outcome: Route calls to your own answering provider or the third-party AI answering service you choose. Numberline stays your phone system.

features.name: Ring options
features.buying_question: How should calls ring the team?
features.outcome: Decide how each call rings: one phone, several mobiles at once, or one person first with backups after.

features.name: Custom notifications
features.buying_question: Can I choose which events reach me, and where?
features.outcome: Choose which events reach you and where: calls, texts, and voicemails, delivered to email or the channels you pick.
